description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barbariccia], [Apex Maelstrom (IV) Ability Tracker] and [Apex Maelstrom (IV) Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barbariccia
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Maelstrom (IV) (0~2), removed after using Apex Maelstrom (IV) two times

description.name: Apex Maelstrom (IV) Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Maelstrom (IV) level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Wind abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barbariccia]

description.name: Apex Maelstrom (IV) Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Maelstrom (IV) level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barbariccia]

description.name: IV
description.text: Twenty single attacks (3.15/3.50/3.85 each) capped at 9999/19999/29999, followed by one single attack (34.60/38.06/41.52) capped at 99999 at Apex Maelstrom (IV) level 0/1/2, removes Arcane Dyad Empowered: Barbariccia from the user
